design_notes: A morning flight of under three hours within Europe: none of the business-class grounds applies (no medical certificate, lines 121-122; under nine hours and no overnight travel, lines 124-132), so economy class (lines 102, 119), the cheaper KLM fare, which is the fallback the traveller gives. The train takes over ten hours, far from the 6-hour rail rule. The manager responsible approved the Travel Request form (Annex 1, line 274).
